candidates.description: This feature vector represents medical conditions, pharmacological substances, and health-related treatments.
This vector represents psychoactive substances and recreational drugs.
These tokens represent indefinite quantifiers meaning "some" or "several" across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents the concept of variety and diversity across multiple languages.
This vector represents intensifiers, degree adverbs, and quantifiers used across multiple languages to modify adjectives and verbs.
This vector activates in contexts related to severe psychiatric conditions and mental health disorders such as schizophrenia and paranoia.
This feature activates on terms related to the concepts of using, utilization, or application across multiple languages.
This vector represents the concept of semantic relation, comparison, and association between items or concepts.
This vector represents concepts related to obstacles, challenges, and consequential outcomes in human endeavors.
This feature activates on terms related to changing, modifying, or scaling the magnitude, intensity, or state of something.
